title: Congress and League adopt the Lucknow Pact
detail: At Lucknow, the two organizations agreed on a joint constitutional reform scheme that accepted separate electorates and proposed provincial seat allocations.

title: Bengal allocation set at 40 percent
detail: Under the pact’s provincial formula, Muslims were allotted 40 percent of Bengal legislative seats although Muslims formed a majority of the province’s population. Some Bengal Muslim leaders criticized the allocation; accounts of the local response require further source work.
